cues: هنا خلاص أيقنَ الآن أصحابُ النبيِّ
فقام أبو بكر الصديق فتكلَّم فأحسن
ثم قام عمر الفاروق فتكلَّم فأحسن
ثم قام المقداد وقال كلامًا عظيمًا
قال: يا رسول الله، آمنّا بك وصدّقناك
واللهِ يا رسول الله لا نقول لك
﴿ اذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنَّا هَاهُنَا قَاعِدُونَ ﴾
بل نقول: اذهب أنت وربك فقاتلا
شهدتُ موقفًا من المقداد وددتُ أني صاحبُه

shots.name: SH01
shots.note: Wadi Dhafran at night, slow push-in revealing the camp

shots.name: SH02
shots.note: the camp: spears planted, shield, sword - fighting is now certain

shots.name: SH03
shots.note: group turns toward the off-screen point, no figure shown

shots.name: SH04
shots.note: camera pans to the Ansar (more numerous); one places a hand on his chest at "bay'ahu fil-'Aqabah"

shots.name: SH06
shots.note: slow pull-out: the small camp far from Madinah in the open wadi

shots.name: SH08
shots.note: Abu Bakr rises, gestures, speaks well

shots.name: SH10
shots.note: al-Miqdad prepares, shifts weight and rises; cloak settles

shots.name: SH11
shots.note: medium low-angle; hand to chest on "amanna bika wa saddaqnak"

shots.name: SH12
shots.note: sacred quotation: calm, still, silence of effects

shots.name: SH13
shots.note: peak: low angle, stillness after the step

shots.name: SH15
shots.note: over Ibn Masud toward al-Miqdad; hand to chest on "wadidtu"

shots.name: SH16
shots.note: pre-dawn valley: same mountains, time passed; title
